The Fiscal Decentralisation Policy and Implementation Strategy 2025-2029 sets a plan led by the Ministry of Finance's Fiscal Decentralisation Division with the Ministry of Local Government and local councils to run property tax roll-out pilots and develop scaling-up plans, and to update revenue databases for major own-source revenues.

The policy says local tax administration is to be streamlined to reduce delays in printing local tax receipts, and councils are to be allowed to buy these receipts directly from the government printers, so these receipts are printed on paper.

The strategy cites the 2020 Auditor General's report as finding in councils receipt books not submitted for inspection, receipts issued with blank duplicates and revenue not banked or accounted for, so councils recorded own-source revenue on paper receipts.
The strategy cites the 2020 Auditor General's report as finding that councils lacked a database for registered businesses and properties.
